title: Tracker Upgrade, Nov 27
subtitle: One upgrade brings in every change from the last two days: dotted lines and room in the boxes, planned savings inside Fixed Costs, utilities from the same month last year, and shaded alternate rows.
intro: The code is already in your Sheet. One run of the upgrade brings in everything listed below; your Month, Compare with and months settings stay as they are, and no entered rows change.

**What changes in the numbers:** Fixed Costs now includes planned savings and takes utilities from the same month last year (each utility on its own; quarterly water uses its average). Likely Left Over is coming in − fixed costs − flexible. Everything else stays the same.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before upgrade 1.37 2026-11-27`.
Reload the Sheet. Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.37.1`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload again.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.done: The report finishes without errors. It can take a little longer than usual because every table gets its shading.
A dotted line runs from each name to its amount, and the amounts sit a little in from the edge. **Fixed Costs** lists Bills, Debt payments, Utilities (with last year's month) and Planned savings.

steps.text: Look at the credit card table at the top.
steps.done: It sits right beside the accounts table, with no empty column between them.

steps.text: Scroll to the tables (Month by month, Savings & Reserves, Debts).
steps.done: Every other row is a slightly darker shade. Next Due shows a date for the car loan and the tax debt.
The boxes have dotted lines, and the tables below have every other row shaded. Fixed spending includes the full rent.
Every other row is shaded. Rows colored for a reason (deleted, missing a category) keep their color.
The Financial Summary cards line passes.
